_comment: Three extra training halls (idea I6): a greeter our own characters file stands in a town that has no disc gym, and on talk opens the game gym screen (web/gym.js) with the existing drill menu cut down to the hall theme. Only drill ids (the compact 1-24 ids of progression.json gym.rank_menus) are stored here, never a table row: the screen reads each drill row, its gain curve, its TP cost and its ultra rules from the game at run time, so a hall trains exactly like a disc gym at that rank. A tier picks the rank_menus group (0-based, the same index the disc greeters write) and the drill ids kept from that menu. Rank gate = ID cards as on the disc: PlatinumID 42 -> platinum; SilverID 40 + GoldID 41 -> gold; SilverID 40 -> silver; none -> none. npc_id and position are mirrored in data/authored/quests/new_characters.json (the greeter sprite and place).

halls.name: Windrunner Dojo
greeting: Welcome to the Windrunner Dojo. We train speed and wisdom here, nothing else.

halls.name: Ironwall Gym
greeting: This is the Ironwall Gym. We build defence and a thick skin of health.

halls.name: Titan Forge
greeting: Welcome to the Titan Forge. Strength first, and a deep well of MP behind it.
